source.reference: Scanned University of Abuja campus plan supplied to the Nelavista team on 2026-11-21. Used only to identify and name places and to read their layout; it is not shown in the app.
source.positions: Each place was located on the campus plan and moved onto real coordinates with an affine fit to six OpenStreetMap road junctions that appear on both (the four corners of the campus ring road and the two points where the academic-core roads meet the southern ring road; OSM nodes 5466013646, 5465941693, 5466013653, 5466013692, 5466013687, 5466013696). Fit error at those junctions is 5-11 m, so positions are good to roughly 15-30 m. OpenStreetMap has the campus outline (way 1133000152) and building shapes but no building names, so none could be taken from it directly.
source.how_to_correct: Edit lat/lng for a place below. A surveyed or OSM-named position should replace the plan-derived one.
